metrics.runtime_scope: selected reconstruction methods, shared wall time

warnings: Experimental one-way jbubble volume-flow → j-Wave 2D coupling. An explicit out-of-plane equivalent line length defines the 3D-to-2D conversion. FIR bandwidth filtering, CT-derived fluid medium and no acoustic feedback. RF is 2D model pressure divided by drive pressure; no 3D pressure equivalence or calibrated measurement.
Receive layout uses point elements with actual array positions and angles; finite element width, directivity and transmit steering are not modelled.

Experimental CT-derived 2D fluid c/rho model with thresholded HU mixture. Air/soft tissue are replaced by host fluid. No absorption or elastic/shear modes; homogeneous straight-ray receive reconstruction remains uncorrected. HU calibration is user-defined, not a patient-specific acoustic measurement.
Emission-time gate truncates a source waveform.

bubble.drive: Hann-windowed sine; centre equals source emission_s
bubble.source_time_convention: trajectory t=0 is drive centre; retarded propagation adds r/c once

coupling.assumptions: one-way equivalent line source; no acoustic feedback or 3D pressure equivalence
coupling.filter: causal 80 dB Kaiser FIR, full convolution; group delay retained
coupling.injection_equation: jwave Sources value=rho*c*Q_3D/(2*L*dx); summed density rate=rho*Q_3D/(L*dx^2)

ct_source.coordinate_convention: simulation x follows image columns; simulation z follows image rows; physical spacing retained; no patient 3D registration

source.modifications: One axial slice selected. Pixel samples and HU rescale/spacing retained exactly; decompressed to explicit little endian. Metadata rebuilt with public-reference identifiers; patient/study/private fields are not copied. ImagePosition reset to local zero; no patient 3D registration. source.title: Open dataset of annotated DICOM images of head CTA for intracranial aneurysm detection

propagation.boundary: absorbing PML; no rigid or reflecting boundary

ct_model.model: thresholded linear HU bone fraction, fluid c/rho; air/soft tissue replaced by host fluid; zero absorption; no shear modes

live_geometry.observer: ordered actual solver samples; no effect on numerical state
live_geometry.spatial_filter: Fourier low-pass at 0.45/stride cycles per original sample, before preview decimation

plan.dimension: 2D x-z; line-source spreading, not a 3D point emitter
plan.mapping: bilinear source injection and receiver interpolation; channel order preserved
plan.time_convention: source evaluated at step midpoint; pressure recorded after step at start+(n+1)*dt; resampled to capture_t0+n/fs

simulation.rf_unit: 2D model pressure divided by drive pressure
